data.one_liner: A Dart library for creating, signing, decoding and verifying JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
data.what_it_does: It provides a simple API to generate JWTs with any supported algorithm, sign them with secret or key, decode tokens without verification, and verify signatures and claims. It also supports JWK conversion and defensive claim handling.
use_when: You need to issue or validate JWTs in a Dart/Flutter app
You require support for multiple algorithms (HS, RS, ES, EdDSA)
You want a pure Dart implementation without external native dependencies
avoid_when: You only need to parse JWTs without verification
You are building a minimal app that prefers a lighter dependency
strengths: Defensive type checks and timing-attack resistant HMAC
Pure Dart, works on all platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in token storage or refresh flow
No integration with auth backends out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: not a JWT library, but can be used for value objects
